collection.description: After a baby's arrival, one parent is worn out and needs uninterrupted sleep.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a baby's arrival, one parent is worn out and needs uninterrupted sleep. The father, (name1), takes charge of the household and discovers that a newborn's schedule is no schedule at all.

choices.label: Handle the Next Round of Care

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: His partner wakes rested and grateful.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby wakes repeatedly, and he asks for help with one task.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: He keeps the household fed through a hectic day.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: He burns the first pot while soothing the baby.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family receives help without losing privacy.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A visitor overstays, and he gently sends them home.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The plan reduces confusion and gives everyone a break.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The baby ignores the plan entirely, so they improvise.
